# Daily Briefing – Saturday 18 July

Yesterday was a rest day with 7,011 steps and 2,389 kcal burned — essentially maintenance, which is fine. The concern is sleep: just 5.3 hours is genuinely short, and your HRV dropped to 93ms against your 101–119ms baseline. Your body is telling you it's running a small deficit in recovery right now.

That said, your resting HR of 48bpm and stress score of 25/100 are both excellent — so this isn't a crisis, just a nudge. Today I'd recommend keeping any planned session moderate rather than pushing hard intervals. A comfortable easy run or steady aerobic work is smart; nothing that demands peak output.

On nutrition, prioritise hitting your 175g protein today — especially since sleep was short and muscle repair is compromised overnight. A protein-rich breakfast within an hour of waking will make a real difference. You're 63 days out — protect the process.
